authorization.rationale: The phase list and the subset that spends money used to be restated inside the workflow, once in the launch gate and once in the provenance record. The two copies drifted: the gate admitted pass0 while the record only recognised audit, so the authorized pass0 run published full_run_authorized=false and looked unauthorized in its own trail. Both the workflow and the provenance writer now read these lists from here, so there is one authority and no second copy to fall out of step.
authorization.reporting_contract: Provenance must report the requested value, whether the phase consults it, and whether it was actually spent, under three separate names. A single field cannot answer those three questions and reading it as any one of them is how the discrepancy went unnoticed.

determinism.pcrelate_verification: compare sample order, pair count, training set and pairs above the primary threshold rather than requiring identical floating-point output
determinism.rationale: snpgdsPCA(algorithm='randomized') draws a random test matrix. Measured on the synthetic fixture, two unseeded runs over identical input produced eigenvectors differing by up to 0.97, and a fixed seed reduced that difference to exactly zero. Those scores propagate to PC-Relate, to the training set and to the candidate list, so the seed is fixed before the run and recorded with the result.
seeded_operations: snpgdsPCA randomized SVD in pass0, in the training-set refit and in the projection

gates.G1_marker_qc_and_ld_pruning: manual scientific review required; no forced SNP count
gates.G2A_pca_technical_integrity: PASS required; a failure aborts the PCA stage. See pca_axis_contract.g2a_technical_integrity.
gates.G2B_axis_localization: measured and reported per axis and per configuration prefix. REVIEW is not a failure and does not abort; it blocks donor certification only. See pca_axis_contract.g2b_axis_localization.
gates.G3_pcrelate_iteration: pass0 and pass1 retained; candidate instability handled conservatively
gates.G4_baseline_disjointness: no exact identity or phi>=0.0442 edge to any baseline donor
gates.G5_candidate_independence: no phi>=0.0442 edge inside final set in any configuration

operational_amendments.change: split reusable marker preparation from the PC-Relate resource benchmark
operational_amendments.trigger: m27d-resource-smoke-20260814b reached its one-hour limit after conversion and both LD-pruning passes but before PC-Relate

operational_amendments.change: split G2 into G2A technical integrity, G2B axis localisation and G2C ancestry representativeness; only G2A aborts, G2B reports PASS or REVIEW on the prefix each configuration reads, and G2C is left NOT_ADJUDICATED_REQUIRES_CALIBRATION
operational_amendments.trigger: The single G2 verdict aborted a run whenever any axis of max_pcs fell below the fraction, so a four-component configuration was blocked in the PCA stage by an eleventh axis it never reads. The participation ratio was also being read as evidence of a family component, which it cannot be: it measures localisation, and an isolate, a small differentiated population, a technical group or a metadata gap produce localisation as well. The fraction itself was not moved, and the enforcement was not removed: it moved from the PCA stage to donor certification, which is later and therefore costs the PC-Relate passes.
operational_amendments.what_changed_besides_the_number: The number did not move. The place where it bites did: the PCA stage no longer aborts on localisation, and donor certification refuses instead. That is the honest accounting, and it has a price: a run that would have stopped before paying for the PC-Relate passes now pays for them first.
operational_amendments.why_certification_still_aggregates: final_related_edge_rule is the union across all preregistered configurations, so a certified donor is exposed to every prefix and not only to its own.

pass0_checkpoint.note: expected_pairs is written as an absolute number on purpose. Comparing the observed count against n(n-1)/2 recomputed from the same n is self-consistent and cannot detect a change in the eligible universe.

checks: the score table carries exactly the eligible samples, once each, in the eligible order
the training set is contained in the eligible universe and has no duplicates
the projection reuses the SNP loadings of the single fit and is not a second fit
the number of components equals the largest preregistered n_pcs
g2a_technical_integrity.honest_scope: Most of these restate a guard the stage already enforces with an earlier abort, so they document what was checked rather than add a new way to fail. The one that can genuinely fire on correct-looking input is the finiteness of the scores: the sample projection can return NaN for a sample the loadings cannot score, and nothing upstream looks. The seed is reported rather than checked, because comparing the applied value against the contract value it was taken from is a tautology.
g2a_technical_integrity.rationale: These are properties of the computation rather than of the cohort. A non-finite score, a permuted sample order or a second independent fit makes every downstream number meaningless, and no calibration can rescue it. This is the only part of G2 that can legitimately stop a run on its own.

g2b_axis_localization.confounding_note: Source and Ancestry are not independent in this panel; their association with an axis is descriptive only.
g2b_axis_localization.effective_individuals_metric: participation ratio 1/sum(w_i^2), w_i = v_i^2 normalised over the axis
g2b_axis_localization.evaluated_on: the leading prefix each configuration reads, never on max_pcs
g2b_axis_localization.operating_threshold_requires_calibration: The 2 percent value is provisional and marks the axes that deserve a look, not the axes that are wrong. Before any donor is certified the observed distribution of participation ratios has to be inspected and the operating value justified against it, together with the populations that carry each flagged axis.
g2b_axis_localization.rationale: The participation ratio measures how many individuals effectively carry an axis, which is a real and label-free measurement. What it cannot do is name the cause: a localised axis may be a family, a small differentiated population, an isolate, a technical group or a set of samples with no metadata row, and PC-Relate legitimately needs axes that describe small differentiated populations in order to estimate individual-specific allele frequencies there. Turning the measurement into an automatic verdict would remove exactly the structure the estimator has to condition on. Associating axes with Source cannot answer the question either: in this panel Source is confounded with ancestry by construction, so a genuine ancestry axis separates sources strongly.
reported_per_axis: carrying Population, Ancestry and Source with their weight fractions
fraction of the axis carried by samples without a resolved metadata row
review_does_not_block: diagnostic phases that certify no donor

inputs_required: per-population membership before the kinship filter
per-population survival inside the training set
populations left with a single member
populations whose induced kinship graph is a complete clique
g2c_ancestry_representativeness.question: whether the set the PCA is fitted on still represents the small populations well enough for its components to describe ancestry
g2c_ancestry_representativeness.why_not_adjudicated: Independence under the kinship graph and representativeness of a population are different properties, and a set can satisfy the first while losing the second. No threshold is declared here because inventing one before measuring the per-population survival of the training set would be choosing a number to fit a result.

pca_axis_contract.structure_note: G2 used to be a single verdict that mixed a technical check, a localisation measurement and a representativeness question, and it aborted a run on the third of those under the name of the first. They are separated here because only the technical check can fail a run by itself.

pcrelate.snp_block_rationale: Fixed rather than left to the GWASTools default so the number of blocks in flight, and therefore the peak memory, is a declared quantity instead of a library default that could change between versions.

resource_smoke.architecture: persistent marker preparation followed by reusable PC-Relate benchmark

arm_marker_scaling.sampling: samples stratified by source and ancestry; SNPs distributed across 22 autosomes

resource_smoke.cleanup: no persistent Batch VM or disk after completion
resource_smoke.selection_rule: smallest thread count within 20 percent of fastest and peak RAM below 70 percent of request

selection.alternative_order_control: repeat deterministic maximal-independent-set construction with ascending and descending stable identifier hash after call-rate ordering; report both, never select the largest
selection.baseline_relative_exclusion: exclude candidate related at phi>=0.0442 in any configuration
selection.candidate_internal_independence: deterministic maximal independent set on union graph
selection.population_coverage_policy: report loss of any observed stratum; do not alter selection order post hoc

stop_rules: Stop on identity, build, chromosome or REF/ALT mismatch.

Stop if ancestry PCs are dominated by family components or technical source. The participation ratio does not establish this on its own: it measures localisation, and a small differentiated population produces localisation too. Adjudicating this rule needs evidence G2B does not carry.
Stop if a conservative independent and baseline-disjoint NAM candidate set cannot be formed.
Stop before Gnomix or simulation if M27C readiness recomputed on final donors is below 0.80.
Do not choose a parameter configuration after observing which one retains more donors.
Do not launch the full run when the smoke exceeds its cost or time ceiling.
